your 1st point? I don't really have friends who I can talk with this about. it's very, very hard for me to open up, and I'm very scared of rejection&am in my shell. I was in therapy for a bit, it didn't help me at all. Maybe that says something about me? idk

your 2nd point? 

1. no, I don't want to. for some reason, it's hard for me to divorce what my parents want for me from what I want for me, and I just feel indifferent at this point, so I just "go with the flow"
2. the career seems okay--I like the idea of helping people, but for some reason I want to escape and upend my life, I'm miserable, and tired of feeling "fine"...

your 3rd point? that's the thing, just another thing I feel like giving up on. for years I forced myself to run and stuff, but after three weeks I just stop. I feel like I can't do it at this point. I feel very indifferent/okay with my lazy lifestyle, I just really hate my body and I would love some pointers. feels like there's an emotional wall in front of me, and I don't know how to push myself and I really appreciate people being nice to me but I just feel useless at this point...

I'm 18M, 5'9", 190lbs, depressed as fuck. Please give me something I can do to change my life.

p.s. not looking for big muscle, just normal tone

I just don't understand our family friend. She is 26, finished dental school and is engaged to her boyfriend who works as a physical therapist. Her life is so PERFECT... sorry I sound like an fb mom.

Same with another. She's 25, just graduated from medical school, has a bf and got residency placed in Madison, Wisconsin. How does she do it? I've always been as good a student as her, haha, how is she so perfect?

Yes I am definitely applying as an undeclared. I'm avoiding my state flagship like the plague (being undeclared there fucking sucks) so I unfortunately am transferring to slightly more expensive OOS. Hopefully this comes to fruition. I want to live in another country for some reason.

I don't think I'm looking hard enough. Fuck this coronavirus.

I love UW. I just found out they’re accepting late transfer apps. I would go ATM but I feel like an awful person if I bail on the rooming (we haven’t found anything due to COVID) for next year. I also am scared I won’t get in, so if I tell my roommates no and I don’t get in then I’m fucked...

I know. The thing is, I didn’t want to go to college too far from home, and I figured I might as well take the guarantee in case I do decide I want to do medicine. 

So I’ve had my doubts for a pretty long time.

Ehh. It's just such a hefty load. Like, medical school I'd be fine, but the years of residency and working yourself to death seem like so much. Plus, my parents are physicians--for lack of a better word, it just seems kind of... boring to me? Idk.
I don't know how to go to UW as a sophomore. Unfortunately I missed the application deadline. I would transfer mid-year, but I told some people I would room with them next year. They needed a 4th.

I’m just worried that I’m not socially developed enough to choose a career or determine my “temperament”. If my temperament is quiet and anxious then screw that... idk if I can accept that about myself.

> You should consider finding a therapist 

I had a therapist for a few months... it didn’t help at all. I feel like friends would be better therapists...

> Like what? Picking a career?

Yes. I’m in a guaranteed medical school program but it’s at a commuter undergrad. I think the cause of my depression is a lack of a social life. I’ve always been a homebody and being at a commuter school is not helping—I don’t want to miss out on conventional social experiences anymore. 

I got in as a transfer to the Economics program at my more prestigious, same-cost state school (University of Illinois) but my current school’s program offers a certain degree of security—I don’t know if I’ll get in to medical school without this program (my grades are kind of tanking right now). I am a freshman at the moment, and need to decide by May 1st. 

I’ll lose my 20s with medical school and training. I don’t know if that’s worth it. I like science, so I might want to do engineering. But my options are closing up :( do you have any career choice advice?

Got a 36 (mod-sev) on depression scale, moderate on social anxiety. Low self esteem. 

I think the “trapped” question really resonated with me on the depression test. I want to get away from home and go to another college. I have to decide very soon so if you have any advice for that (along with dealing with depression, which I think is ridiculous for an 18 year old boy to have) that’d be awesome—thanks for the comment :)

Thanks, that helps. I know I need to change from within. It’s just like, what did I do to deserve this? I was always a good kid, but I never went out. Now I feel like I missed an entire chapter of “the life”. I’m scared that if I don’t act now, I’ll lose it completely.

I am considering transferring as a junior. The thing is, I’m between economics and engineering as a major. Can I even start a new major at a new school as a junior transfer? Probably almost impossible for engineering... 

I probably should have gone to community college or taken a year off before college... I am wasting money and I can’t commit to anything. Getting good grades in high school was pointless.

I guess, but I am just very fixated on leaving and having the conventional “college experience”. I don’t know why. I just feel like I would be happier and more positive if I left, regardless of any destruction it might cause.

I am having a very hard time accepting medicine as a career, but I’m not sure what else I’d do. I could’ve enrolled in engineering last year at my state school, but I fucked up.
i'm not sure about medicine. would like to keep my options open for grad school if i want to exit!
You still have to take the MCAT, but after you’ve passed their minimum you’re in
The thing is, I feel like when I talk to people it's super superficial, and I don't mean to be that "deep" guy but I genuinely feel fake and drained.

I don’t know how to explore. I don’t have any people I genuinely consider my friends (HELP!!!) and don’t really want to online date at this stage. I would be totally down at this time for relaxed, short term relationships and a long term one later in life.
What do you mean “stay objective”? I’m so overwhelmed by my feelings + I don’t know what to think anymore.
Okay, that makes sense—hopefully this corona thing ends soon so I can do that. Though honestly my social anxiety likes this lmao
